messages.text: Giant Sequoia stakes Classic claims in Futurity

metadata.summary: Giant Sequoia produced an eyecatching performance to win the William Hill Futurity Trophy at Doncaster and in the process virtually guarantee Aidan O’Brien the trainers’ championship.
metadata.content: Giant Sequoia powers to impressive Futurity Trophy success | Racing News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Giant Sequoia powers to impressive Futurity Trophy success Aidan O'Brien looks to have another Classic contender on his hands as Giant Sequoia bounced back to form with an emphatic success in the Group One Futurity Trophy at Doncaster. Saturday 24 October 2026 17:33, UK Image: Giant Sequoia, ridden by Dylan Browne McMonagle, on their way to winning the William Hill Futurity Trophy Stakes at Doncaster Giant Sequoia produced an eyecatching performance to win the William Hill Futurity Trophy at Doncaster and in the process virtually guarantee Aidan O’Brien the trainers’ championship. It was stablemate Sergei Diaghilev who set a brisk pace at the head of the Group One field, before the race began to take shape as they hit the two-furlong pole, with all the runners on the stands side. Ryan Moore and favourite Noble Exhibit put down their challenge a furlong and a half out, but Giant Sequoia (11-1) was travelling strongly upsides and really picked up when asked by Dylan Browne McMonagle, stretching three lengths clear of Andrew Balding's staying-on Gran Dia. It was a record-extending 13th success in the race for O'Brien, who had been happy to draw a line through the winner's disappointing effort in last month's National Stakes.
